name: show-me-the-prd-codex
description: Codex-native draft-first PRD generator — probe the real problem, draft 4 design documents immediately, confirm assumptions in one batch.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a rough idea into a draft-first five-file PRD bundle in Codex
interface.longDescription: Package the Codex-native `show-me-the-prd` skill with chat-first numbered-choice rules: one open probe for the real problem, one direction round, an immediate 4-document draft (plus README) with an assumption ledger, one confirmation round, and optional UI design-reference collection.
defaultPrompt: Turn this rough app idea into a draft-first PRD bundle with scope, data model, phases, project spec, and an assumption ledger.
Use show-me-the-prd to normalize these planning notes into a five-file handoff.
Help me clarify this product idea with one open question and two numbered-choice rounds, then write the PRD files.
